steps: n5(bars, asof): median true range (FORMULAS.md 12) of completed 5-minute bars of the trailing 20 UTC days, as a fraction of close; reuse tom_noise_units.true_ranges.
min_stop_width(entry, n5, fees) = max(0.88 * n5, round-turn fee fraction / 0.25) * entry; a signal with a narrower stop is dropped with reason stop_below_min_width, never widened.
Off by default (argument min_width=False): existing tom_bt outputs identical. Report the floor at lookback 10 and 40 beside 20; choose nothing.
